summary: Oglethorpe Power Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the redemption of $250M of its 4.550% First Mortgage Bonds due 2044 and $47.8M of its 5.534% First Mortgage Bonds due 2035 on June 29, 2026. The bonds will be redeemed at par plus accrued interest and a make-whole amount, respectively, using proceeds from a zero-interest Rural Utilities Service loan closed May 12, 2026 under the New ERA program. The issuer intends to issue commercial paper as a temporary bridge. This refinancing is a routine debt management event, not a special situation. Watch for closing of the loan advance.
